explanation: hypomapAtlasClient.test.ts tests the HypoMap atlas client through its in-memory transport (checksums, gzip and host-decoded files, cohort check, alias/ambiguous/outside-export resolution, the shared per-symbol load, metrics, mean/SEM and the CSV tables) and absorbs hypomapMetrics.test.ts, which is removed. hypomapFixture.ts builds the fixture export; the preview and co-expression view tests read it through the transport instead of mocking loadAtlasGene, and csvDialog.test.tsx checks the atlas provenance columns.
